title: fix(app-shell): four Studio editors open no buffer over a draft the server refuses to read
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb6XXaS1k5WoFSG9mHkAJSe5)_

Part of #29148 (PR 1 of 2, the split the claim amendment 6574316242 records; PR 2 takes the Interfaces app nav, object, object-extension and flow loads in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` and `ResourceEditPage.tsx`, and is the one that completes the card).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The two lines are copied from the claim (comment 6574269114) and its amendment (comment 6574316242).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：列表视图检查器、邮件模板/翻译表单编辑器、权限矩阵（包草稿入口）、钩子面板这四个 Studio 编辑器，读草稿遇到服务器 403（草稿带受众门 `requiredPermissions`，作者无权读）时，不再当成"没有草稿"去打开已发布版本，而是显示同一条拒绝说明，服务器原话放在"详情"里，自动保存没有内容可发。
- 为什么改：之前这几个编辑器会把已发布版本当作编辑起点，下一次自动保存把它写成草稿，悄悄抹掉草稿里的权限门和其他未发布改动，发布后该项对所有人可见。#29015 只修了 Interfaces 的叶子项，本 PR 修其中四个编辑器，其余在 PR 2。
- 风险与回滚：只影响草稿读取返回 403 的项；无草稿、可读草稿、其他读取失败的路径不变。钩子面板只拦被拒的那个钩子，其余钩子照常。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`ObjectHooksPanel.tsx`（部分拒绝的处理）；`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` 加载处的 `'refused' in pendingRead` 分支与两处渲染；`StudioBundleItemEditor.tsx` 错误条新增的"详情"。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectHooksPanel.draftUnreadable-29148.test.tsx`，预期 3 个用例通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`readDraftForSave` has handed a draft read refused `403` back as `refused` since #29132. These four editors now act on it the way the Interfaces leaf load does: no buffer is installed, the `engine.studio.refusal.draftUnreadable` sentence shows with the server's own sentence (`formatMetadataError`) behind Details, and the autosave has nothing to send. No new i18n key.

- `studio-design/ObjectListViewInspector.tsx` (`useObjectListViewDraft`): a refused view draft read leaves the buffer unloaded (`for: ''`, `row: null`) and sets `failure` to the new `draftUnreadable` arm, which the panel's existing refusal host renders. The published layer is not read.
- `studio-design/StudioBundleItemEditor.tsx`: a refused read installs no draft, clears the guard's pins (`forget`), and shows neither the form nor the preview. The editor's error host now renders a Details disclosure when a refusal carries one (only this refusal does today).
- `metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` (package door, load only): a refused read installs no matrix; the strip replaces it in both presentations (routed page and the Studio Access pillar), and the autosave is blocked. The pre-save re-read (it already refuses the save when the draft read answers nothing) and the post-save verdict re-read (installs nothing) are unchanged, per the claim amendment.
- `studio-design/ObjectHooksPanel.tsx`: the list load keeps the refused hooks by name. A refused hook stays listed by its published row, pins nothing, and opens no buffer: selecting it shows the strip in the detail pane. A partial refusal holds only that hook; the other hooks load, edit and save as before. A hook known only by its refused draft is not listed, as today: nothing says it fires on this object.

## Tests

One new file per editor, each with a refused case, a control (no pending draft: the published body opens and the first save is pinned `If-None-Match: *`), and for the hooks panel a partial-refusal case.

- `ObjectListViewInspector.draftUnreadable-29148.test.tsx` (2): the real hook and panel over a real `MetadataClient` and an in-memory server whose `?state=draft` read answers 403.
- `StudioBundleItemEditor.draftUnreadable-29148.test.tsx` (2)
- `PermissionMatrixEditor.draftUnreadable-29148.test.tsx` (3): routed page, Studio presentation, control.
- `ObjectHooksPanel.draftUnreadable-29148.test.tsx` (3): refused, partial refusal, control.

Ablation, one per editor (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, guard turned into `false && …`, restore proven blob == HEAD): each refused case goes red and each control stays green.

## Acceptance notes

- Each editor renders the strip in its own refusal host, in the Studio refusal strip's look. Moving `StudioRefusalStrip` into a shared module, so every editor draws the one component, is PR 2's (it edits `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, which open PR #29224 also edits).
- Changed lines 843: 162 in the four editors, 669 in the four new test files, 12 in the changeset.
